Permutation-based p-values are unstable for very small sets — the minimum set size cutoff must be stated
Leading-edge genes are the interpretable output; a significant NES with a leading edge of two or three genes is weak evidence regardless of the adjusted p

GSEA on the full ranking is preferred to over-representation of a thresholded list here: with 6 vs 6 the significant-gene list may be short, and a rank-based test uses the whole signal. steps.question: Which of the 50 MSigDB hallmark pathways are coordinately up- or down-regulated in atopic dermatitis lesional skin relative to control, and do those hallmark calls survive excluding sample_01?
constraints: Use the full ranked list from T1S2, not a padj-thresholded subset — this is preranked GSEA, not over-representation
Use the human hallmark GMT; the mouse hallmark file is present in the same collection and must not be used on these human samples
Set a fixed random seed so the permutation p-values are reproducible, and report the number of permutations used
Do not report a hallmark as changed on the basis of the full-cohort run alone if the sample_01-excluded run contradicts it — report both and label stability
If the hallmark collection is unavailable, say so and label any substituted collection explicitly rather than presenting it as hallmark
steps.description: Run rank-based gene set enrichment (fgsea, or GSEApy prerank) on the primary ranked gene list from T1S2 against the human hallmark gene set collection — the reference needed is the MSigDB hallmark sets for Homo sapiens as a symbol-keyed GMT; resolve it against the reference store rather than hardcoding a path, and confirm it is the human collection, not the mouse one, before use. Full hallmark result table: NES, nominal p, BH-adjusted p, set size in the tested universe, and leading-edge genes per set

Direction of NES stated in terms of lesional versus control, not as an unsigned score

plan.title: AD lesional vs control DE + hallmark GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a single-batch bulk RNA-seq count matrix from Salmon (12,000 gene symbols x 12 samples) with an unpaired 6 lesional atopic-dermatitis vs 6 control design, plus a 12x2 sample table. The research question has two parts — which genes change, and which hallmark pathways change — and one explicit data concern: sample_01 has a library size roughly 4x below the median.

Track 1 addresses the shallow library first, because every downstream number depends on how it is handled. Rather than deciding in advance to drop it, T1S1 quantifies whether sample_01 is merely shallow (low depth, normal composition, groups with its condition after normalisation) or genuinely aberrant (outlying on PCA/Cook's distance/sample-sample correlation beyond what depth explains). Median-of-ratios or TMM size factors absorb depth differences by construction, so a 4x-shallower library is usually retainable; what it costs is precision on low-count genes, not validity. The decision is then made on evidence and carried explicitly into T1S2.

T1S2 runs the DESeq2 negative-binomial test on the full 12-sample matrix (~condition, lesional vs control) with independent filtering and shrunken log2 fold changes, and — this is the point of the shallow-sample handling — repeats the identical contrast with sample_01 excluded (6 vs 5). Concordance between the two DE tables is the actual evidence that the result does not rest on one questionable library. The full-cohort table is primary unless T1S1 flagged sample_01 as aberrant on grounds other than depth, in which case the 11-sample table becomes primary; either way both are reported.

Track 2 takes the ranked gene list from T1S2 and tests the 50 MSigDB human hallmark sets by GSEA on the full shrunken-LFC ranking, not by over-representation of a thresholded list — with n=6 per group and only 12,000 genes profiled, a hard FDR cut may leave too few genes for ORA to be informative, and a rank-based test uses the whole signal. Hallmark sets are gene symbols (HGNC) and the counts are keyed on gene symbol, so no identifier conversion is needed; the universe is restricted to genes that survived independent filtering, and leading-edge genes are reported so each enriched hallmark is traceable to the genes driving it. The hallmark result is also recomputed on the sample_01-excluded ranking so pathway conclusions inherit the same robustness check.
